regulatorySource: Regulation (EU) No 1321/2014 Annex II (Part-145) consolidated up to ED Decision 2024/008/R & Regulation (EU) 2023/203 (Part-IS)

rules.name: Physical Segregation of Quarantine / Unserviceable Components
rules.expectedOutcome: Dedicated quarantine holding room modeled with physical partition boundaries.
rules.limitations: Physical security lock status must be confirmed via MOE Chapter 2.2 procedures.

rules.name: Secure Bonded Parts Store Presence & Access Control
rules.expectedOutcome: Dedicated secure bonded store modeled for serviceable aeronautical parts.
rules.limitations: Inventory segregation controls require WMS / ERP documentary verification.

rules.name: Workshop Door Clear Opening Width for ULD Pallet Handling
rules.sourceDocument: EASA AMC & GM to Part-145 (ED Decision 2015/029/R)
rules.expectedOutcome: Bay cargo doors have clear opening width >= 2,950 mm for PMC 96-in pallets.
rules.limitations: Evaluates parametric Clear Opening Width. Physical threshold and frame clearances require site punch-list.

rules.name: Emergency Eyewash Proximity to Chemical / Battery Station
rules.expectedOutcome: Emergency eyewash station located within 15 meters travel distance.
rules.limitations: EASA Part-145 does not prescribe 15m; this is an industrial hygiene assumption citing ANSI Z358.1.

rules.name: Maintenance Tooling Asset Identification Parameters
rules.expectedOutcome: Structural squeezer and riveter equipment instances populated with AssetID / Mark.
rules.limitations: Equipment calibration status verified via ISO 17025 certificates.

rules.name: Server & Records Physical Access Security Control
rules.expectedOutcome: Access control card reader or biometric locking specified on server/archive doors.
rules.limitations: Key custody procedures require organizational audit.
